description: Every numeric bound the fidelity gates are derived from. src/metrics.rs measures images and holds no policy; src/verification.rs decides whether a measurement passes, reading these bounds through src/reference.rs. projected_row_angle is the one bound the camera is derived from rather than judged against: its value is measured from the approved key art and CAMERA_ELEVATION_DEGREES follows from it. The document is embedded with include_str! and parsed once, so a run cannot disagree with the repository it is measuring. Not yet frozen: G0 will freeze this document and its hash, after which a change requires authority-only justification, a new near-boundary negative fixture, and a separate G0 recalibration.
